# lgd-skill-review · 技能审计官

> Machine-readable index for AI agents: `AI-INDEX.json`. Human/agent guide: `SKILL.md`. Chinese first, English follows.

## What this is (EN)
A six-dimension auditor for agent skills: every deduction must cite evidence, and every package gets a score, a blocker list and a remediation order — so an author (or an agent) can fix, re-run and raise the score.

## 这是什么（中文）
Agent 技能六维审计器：每一处扣分都必须给出证据，输出分数、阻断项与整改顺序，作者或 AI 可据此整改、复评、再提高。这是我们做「权威评测」的引擎。

## When to use it (EN)
Use when you must judge whether a skill package is safe and complete before installing it, or when you want a score plus concrete remediation steps for a skill you wrote.

## 什么时候用它（中文）
安装前判断一个技能包是否安全完整，或想为自己写的技能拿到分数与可执行整改步骤时使用。

## Entrypoints / 入口命令
```bash
python scripts/review.py <package-dir> --run
python scripts/review.py <package-dir> --run --focus declared-consistency
python tests/run_golden.py
```

## Output (EN)
Per-dimension score, blocking items with file/line evidence, and an ordered remediation list; with --run it executes the package's own golden set instead of trusting the README.

## 输出（中文）
逐维分数、带文件行号的阻断项证据、按优先级排好的整改清单；加 --run 会实际执行包内黄金集，而不是相信 README 的自述。

## Proof you can re-run / 可复跑的证据
- Golden set: 5 cases — `python tests/run_golden.py` prints a pass count and exits 0.
- Differentiator: declared-CLI vs implemented-CLI consistency
- Zero dependencies, offline, no credentials. Standard library only.

## Family / 同族技能（LGD Skills）
- [summarize-pro](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/summarize-pro) — 会议纪要专家
- [debug-pro](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/debug-pro) — 排障专家
- [wechat-viral-topic](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/wechat-viral-topic) — 公众号选题专家

## Evaluation registry / 爆款清单
Audited against six dimensions; passing packages are registered at https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-hit-list with score and receipt.
经六维审计通过后登记于爆款清单 https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-hit-list，附分数与回执。
